qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | assistant professor: As per qualifications laid down by National Medical Commission Regulations Date 30.06.2025 for minimum qualifications for teachers in medical institutions and amended from time to time. MS-CIT Passing Certificate. SSC or HSC Passed with Marathi subject. If the MS-CIT And SSC or HSC with Marathi Subject Passing certificate is not available at the time of interview, it will be mandatory to submit it within three months for MS-CIT and six months for SSC or HSC with Marathi Subject from appointment date. Candidate must furnish attested Xerox copies of undergraduate and Postgraduate Examination passing certificate if passed in more than 1 attempt.

selection_process: Selections will be made as per the NMC norms through an interview conducted at the Chambers of Dean
Mumbai 400 022 according to the scheduled department dates and timings.
how_to_apply: Obtain the prescribed application form from Room No 15, Cash Section (Head Clerk-Cash) of LTMG Hospital & Medical College on working days between 11:00 AM to 3:30 PM.
Fill out the application form entirely in your own handwriting.
Affix a recent passport-size photograph duly on the application form.
Attach attested photocopies of all required certificates, documents, and fee receipts.
Submit the completed application form to the central dispatch section of LTMG Hospital & Medical College Sion, Mumbai 400 022 on or before 16.10.2026 up to 4:00 PM positively.
important_instructions: This appointment is purely on a contract basis until 31.03.2027 and not a regular basis. The candidate appointed on contract basis can be discontinued at any time if not required. Selected candidates will be appointed at LTMG Hospital & Medical College and can be transferred to Municipal Medical College as per requirement. The Municipal Commissioner M.C.G.M. has the right to stop the selection process at any time and at any stage. Selected candidates are only eligible for grant of Casual Leave and Special Casual Leave as per circular No. Director/M.E. & M.H/3644 dated 14.10.2022. If a candidate appointed on contract basis desires to resign, a notice of one month in advance must be submitted. If Assistant Professors become available on a regular basis through direct service, services of candidates appointed on contractual basis will be terminated. Applications received after the prescribed date and time will not be considered under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: LTMGH Assistant Professor Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: A total of 57 vacancies are available for the post of Assistant Professor across various departments on a contract basis.

rows.qualification_required: As per qualifications laid down by National Medical Commission Regulations Date 30.06.2025 for minimum qualifications for teachers in medical institutions and amended from time to time. MS-CIT Passing Certificate. SSC or HSC Passed with Marathi subject. If the MS-CIT And SSC or HSC with Marathi Subject Passing certificate is not available at the time of interview, it will be mandatory to submit it within three months for MS-CIT and six months for SSC or HSC with Marathi Subject from appointment date. Candidate must furnish attested Xerox copies of undergraduate and Postgraduate Examination passing certificate if passed in more than 1 attempt.

content_sections.heading: LTMGH Assistant Professor Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selections will be made as per the NMC norms through an interview conducted at the Chambers of Dean, LTMG Hospital & Medical College Sion, Mumbai 400 022 according to the scheduled department dates and timings.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for LTMGH Assistant Professor
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application form from Room No 15, Cash Section (Head Clerk-Cash) of LTMG Hospital & Medical College on working days between 11:00 AM to 3:30 PM. Fill out the application form entirely in your own handwriting. Affix a recent passport-size photograph duly on the application form. Attach attested photocopies of all required certificates, documents, and fee receipts. Submit the completed application form to the central dispatch section of LTMG Hospital & Medical College Sion, Mumbai 400 022 on or before 16.10.2026 up to 4:00 PM positively.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Birth Certificate School/College Leaving Certificate Domicile Certificate Medical Educational Qualification Certificates & experience certificate MMC/MCI Registration Professional Indemnity Policy Secondary & Higher Secondary School Examination Mark List (Required Marathi Subject) Marriage Certificate & Gazette Copy of NameChange (for married female candidates) PAN Card Aadhar Card Attested Xerox copies of undergraduate and Postgraduate Examination passing certificate if passed in more than 1 attempt MS-CIT passing Certificate No Objection Certificate from previous employer (if in service)

content_sections.heading: LTMGH Assistant Professor Important Instructions
content_sections.text: This appointment is purely on a contract basis until 31.03.2027 and not a regular basis. The candidate appointed on contract basis can be discontinued at any time if not required. Selected candidates will be appointed at LTMG Hospital & Medical College and can be transferred to Municipal Medical College as per requirement. The Municipal Commissioner M.C.G.M. has the right to stop the selection process at any time and at any stage. Selected candidates are only eligible for grant of Casual Leave and Special Casual Leave as per circular No. Director/M.E. & M.H/3644 dated 14.10.2022. If a candidate appointed on contract basis desires to resign, a notice of one month in advance must be submitted. If Assistant Professors become available on a regular basis through direct service, services of candidates appointed on contractual basis will be terminated. Applications received after the prescribed date and time will not be considered under any circumstances.

faq.question: Q1. What is LTMGH Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: LTMGH Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 is an offline recruitment drive conducted by Lokmanya Tilak Municipal General Hospital & Medical College, Sion, Mumbai to fill 57 Assistant Professor posts on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in LTMGH Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 57 vacancies have been announced for Assistant Professor across multiple departments such as Anaesthesia, Biochemistry, Cardiology, Surgery, and others.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form to the central dispatch section of LTMG Hospital & Medical College Sion is 16.10.2026 up to 4:00 PM positively.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for LTMGH Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess minimum qualifications laid down by National Medical Commission Regulations dated 30.06.2025, along with an MS-CIT passing certificate and SSC or HSC passed with Marathi subject.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for LTMGH Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is not more than 38 years for Assistant Professor as on the date of advertisement.
